## Example 1.2 {#ss1-example-1-2}

Consider the finite sequence $7,12,17,22,\ldots,97$, defined by $a_n=5n+2$.

a) State the first term $a_1$:

b) Solve $a_m=97$ to find the final index $m$:

c) Write the final term using subscript notation: $a_{\underline{\hspace{0.6cm}}}=97$

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 2 · Example 1.2 · Complete the working in your booklet.</p>

::: notes
(a) a_1=7. (b) 5m+2=97 gives m=19. (c) a_19=97. Ask what 19 and 97 each describe, without returning to a full inputs/outputs recap.
